reason: The @font-face rules are the one place that names the font families and their files (fonts built in design/fonts, ADR-402); components use the type tokens.

The key "supercharged" is the engine-aspiration enum value of the spec form (turbo, supercharged, naturally aspirated; label "Kompressor"), not marketing copy. Only this member is exempt (DQ-814); JSON has no line comments for a per-line suppression.
